blocks.text: Product Description               Wonderful, restorative things happen while our bodies are at rest. Help relieve symptoms of your Carpal Tunnel wrist injury with the ACE Brand Night Wrist Sleep Support. Crafted from soft, brushed fabric, this wrist support wraps your injured wrist in adjustable comfort. Innovatively designed pad rests in the palm of your hand to help keep your hand in the correct position, and the convenient design simply slips on. Make the ACE Brand Night Wrist Sleep Support a part of your bedtime routine to help your wrist for the day ahead.The ACE Brand guarantees its products to be of the highest quality. If you are not completely satisfied with your ACE Brand product, you may return it within 30 days of purchase, with proof of purchase, for a refund or replacement unless it meets one of the situations below. We do this to protect all our customers and make sure that we handle every return or exchange with reasonable fairness. Products showing wear and tear Products with a missing label or label that has been defaced Products that have been soiled or contaminated, until they have been properly cleaned Products damaged by misuse, abuse, improper care or negligence, or accidents (including pet damage) Products lost or damaged due to fire, flood or natural disaster Past habitual abuse of our Return Policy                  Manufacturer Contact Information               3M

items.label: TURN DISCOMFORT INTO COMFORT
items.value: 1 ACE Brand Night Wrist Sleep Support helps relieve symptoms of carpal tunnel syndrome and other wrist injuries by comfortably holding your wrist in the recommended position all night long

items.label: COMFORTABLE AND SECURE
items.value: Wrist support designed with a palmar splint and cushioning beads to help promote a neutral hand position during sleep

items.label: EASY TO USE
items.value: This support features a sleeve design that offers hassle-free application and adjustments

items.label: ONE SIZE FITS MOST
items.value: Ambidextrous design allows you to wear this support on either wrist so you can use it as a right wrist brace or left wrist brace

items.label: FIT
items.value: It fits wrist sizes 5.25" to 9" when measuring around the smallest part of the wrist

items.label: Warranty
items.value: Subject to the written warranty from the manufacturer that accompanies the product.
